mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (first_name, last_name, email, password, phone, date_of_birth, balance) VALUES (#{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{email}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{dateOfBirth}, COALESCE(#{balance}, 0))
mapper.update:
UPDATE student
first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, date_of_birth = #{dateOfBirth},
password = #{password},
WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM student WHERE student_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM student ORDER BY student_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET points = points + #{n} WHERE student_id = #{id}
UPDATE student SET points = points - #{n} WHERE student_id = #{id} AND points >= #{n}
UPDATE student SET password = #{hash} WHERE student_id = #{id}
